glyph.isekai_mahou.mana_leak.desc: Counters MINOR pending casts on the Stack near the target (MAJOR with Amplify). A player may pay 90 mana to save the spell; without mana, it leaks away. On a player with nothing on the Stack: drains 90 mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.redirect.desc: Enemy projectiles near the target become yours and fly back, faster, at whoever shot them. On yourself: a mirror around you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fork.desc: Copies the last glyph spell cast by SOMEONE ELSE (player, mob or boss) within 16 blocks in the last 4 s and casts it as yours, from you towards your aim. Can't copy ultimates (G) or another copy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spell_steal.desc: Rips up to 6 beneficial effects off the target and puts them on you (Amplify/Extend: they last longer).
glyph.isekai_mahou.deathtouch.desc: Augment: the previous glyph's damage instantly kills any non-boss mob that would drop below 25% health. On bosses: +15% damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trample.desc: Augment: the damage left over on a kill tramples over to the nearest enemy within 5 blocks (up to 3 times).
glyph.isekai_mahou.instant.desc: Augment: the spell goes off at once (0 cast time) and never enters the Stack — it can't be countered. +50% cost.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hexproof.desc: You or an ally become immune to harmful effects and to counterspells for 8 s (current ones are cleansed). Enemy players' spells that hit it charge the attacker 60 mana — without mana, they fizzle.
glyph.isekai_mahou.indestructible.desc: You or an ally can't drop below 1 health for 4 s (golden aegis). Even survives Wrath.
glyph.isekai_mahou.exile.desc: A rift into nothingness swallows a non-boss mob at or below 50% health (+10% per Amplify): it vanishes without loot, but counts as a kill. Bosses and players: Exposed II for 6 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.wrath.desc: A colossal sigil forms in the sky and, 1.5 s later, pillars of light destroy EVERY non-player, non-tamed creature in the area (radius 14 + area) — your summons included. Bosses lose 25% of max health. The ground where the pillars fall turns to glass.
glyph.isekai_mahou.time_walk.desc: On yourself: resets all your cooldowns and restores 30% of your max mana. Own cooldown of 120 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.in_response.desc: Trigger: the slot is READIED. When a hostile cast enters the Stack within 20 blocks, the spell fires by itself at once, aimed at the caster (pays mana, respects cooldown and silence; 1 response per cast). The key doesn't cast it.
